        Pattern p = Pattern.compile("(.)\\1*", Pattern.DOTALL);

        int count = 0;
        while (m.find()) {
            if ((m.group().length() & 1) == 0) {
                count++;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(count);

import java.util.*;

public class Solution {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        String s = sc.nextLine();
        List<Integer> runLengths = new ArrayList<>();
        int i = 0;
        while (i < s.length()) {
            int start = i;
            char ch = s.charAt(i);
            while (i < s.length() && s.charAt(i) == ch) {
                i++;
            }
            runLengths.add(i - start);
        }
        int count = 0;
        for (int len : runLengths) {
            if ((len & 1) == 0) {
                count++;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(count);
        sc.close();
    }
}

import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.*;

public class Solution {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        String s = sc.nextLine();
        int n = s.length();
        int[] bounds = IntStream.rangeClosed(0, n)
                .filter(i -> i == 0 || i == n || s.charAt(i - 1) != s.charAt(i))
                .toArray();
        long count = IntStream.range(0, bounds.length - 1)
                .filter(k -> ((bounds[k + 1] - bounds[k]) & 1) == 0)
                .count();
        System.out.println(count);
        sc.close();
    }
}
